planSteps.description: Navigate to /, scroll 'hero-demo' into view, wait until 'demo-play' is enabled
Click 'demo-play' to pause (confirm 'hero-demo' has data-state='paused'), then click 'demo-restart' once; restart keeps the demo paused. Confirm 'demo-round' reads 'Round 1 / 2'
'demo-round' reads exactly 'Round 2 / 2' and 'demo-outcome' reads 'Golden, Jared F.'
